title: Meeting
subtitle: Say what you need, add a recording or a transcript, and get minutes where every decision and action shows the words behind it.
cap: Audio or video, up to 25 MB.
pastePlaceholder: Rina: let's start. The checkout error budget is at 2.1 percent…

prompt.label: What do you need from this meeting?

runNote: Run is the paid step: it uses your key to transcribe and write the minutes.
runNoteTranslate: Run is the paid step: it uses your key to transcribe, write the minutes and translate them.

drop.title: Drop a recording or a transcript here
drop.hint: or choose a file. Audio or video up to 25 MB, or a transcript as .txt, .md, .vtt, .srt, .docx or .pdf.
drop.free: Adding a file is free. Nothing is paid until you press Run.
drop.another: Drop another file to start a new meeting.
drop.oneFile: Only the first file was added: a meeting holds one recording or transcript.
drop.unsupported: That file is not a recording or a transcript. Use audio or video, or a .txt, .md, .vtt, .srt, .docx or .pdf file.

howItWorks: Drop a recording or a transcript, say what you need, and press Run. Adding a file, reading a transcript and editing the minutes are free. Transcribing, writing the minutes and translating are paid, and run only when you ask.
translateEmpty: There is no translation yet. Press the button to translate the minutes to {language}.
translateDefault: Always translate the minutes when I press Run
translateDefaultHint: Off by default: translating is a second paid call.
noAsr: This gateway key lists no speech-to-text model, so a recording cannot be transcribed here. Paste the transcript and the minutes still work.
noFfmpeg: ffmpeg is not installed, so a recording cannot be read here. Paste the transcript instead.
noFfmpegBundled: The video tools that come with {productName} did not start, so a recording cannot be read here. Reinstall {productName}, or paste the transcript instead.
unverified: {count} name(s) the transcript never said were removed from these minutes.
deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}”? Its recording, transcript and minutes go with it, and this cannot be undone.

record.sourceTabHint: Pick the tab your online meeting is in and tick “Share tab audio”, so the other people are recorded too.
record.capped: The 25 MB limit was reached, so the recording stopped there. Everything up to that point was kept.
record.queued: The recording is waiting to be uploaded…
record.uploadFailed: That recording was not uploaded. It is still here, so try again or save it to your device.
record.uploadFailedFor: The recording for “{title}” was not uploaded. It is still here, so try again or save it to your device.
record.switchLocked: Stop the recording before switching meetings.
record.kept: Everything recorded before it stopped was kept.
record.interrupted: The recording stopped when the desk or the language changed. Everything recorded until then was kept.
record.otherDesk: “{title}” has a recording from another desk that was not uploaded. Switch back to that desk and open Meeting to upload it, or save it to your device.

errors.insecure_context: Recording needs a secure page (https, or localhost). Upload a file instead.
errors.unsupported_browser: This browser cannot record audio. Use Chrome or Edge, or upload a file instead.
errors.permission_denied: The microphone was blocked. Allow it in the browser's site settings, then try again.
errors.no_device: No microphone was found. Plug one in, or upload a file instead.
errors.display_unsupported: This browser cannot share tab audio. Record the microphone alone instead.
errors.display_cancelled: Nothing was shared, so the recording did not start.
errors.display_no_audio: That share carried no audio. Share a tab and tick “Share tab audio”, or record the microphone alone.
errors.recorder_failed: The recording stopped unexpectedly. Try again, or upload a file instead.
errors.empty_recording: Nothing was captured. Check that the right microphone is selected, then try again.

checks.title: These minutes may need a second look
checks.owners: An action item has no task, or an owner the transcript never names.
checks.dates: The minutes quote a date or time the transcript never says.
checks.shape: The minutes did not come back in the shape they should have.
checks.evidence: Some decisions or actions are not backed word for word by the transcript. They are marked “Unverified”.
checks.hint: The minutes are saved. Check them against the transcript, or press “{action}” to write them again.

evidence.allVerified: Every decision and action is backed by words in the transcript.
evidence.someUnverified: Checked against the transcript: {verified} backed, {unverified} unverified. Unverified items are marked below.
evidence.unverifiedHint: The transcript does not back this item word for word. Check it against the transcript, or edit it.

edit.clearsTranslation: Saving clears the translation, which described the old words. Translate again when you are done.

errors.transcriptFile: Could not read that transcript file.
errors.noMeeting: Choose a meeting first, then this recording can be uploaded.
